decisions.reason: The cloud contact centre service builds directly on the firm's existing contact-centre, cloud, network and service-integration capabilities, so under absorptive capacity it is close enough to the knowledge base that early market feedback can be absorbed and used to improve rather than abandon it.

The call number routing platform is highly related to the firm's core voice, numbering, routing and managed network expertise, making it easy for a large German telecom operator with owned infrastructure to refine and scale the offer instead of withdrawing it.
